desc:
⭐ [Welcome to Arcane Piece] ⭐
PC & Mobile supported

If a gamepass didn't give you the ability you bought try resetting your character/rejoining!

Current Level Cap: 500,000!

📌 This game is inspired by Verse Piece, anime based combat, and the average One Piece game.

💬  How to Play:
Farm levels by beating up npcs and defeating bosses to earn loot. You can also use the loot to purchase cool abilities!

💬 How to use codes:
Go to Menu and then the Bird icon.
